thread:
alex-sales: Heads up — Enterprise security asked for an "access controls" packet for the upcoming POC. Must-haves: SSO/SAML attribute map, proof MFA is enforced for privileged users, SCIM provisioning docs showing group-scoped sync, RBAC examples demonstrating least privilege, and one example of service-account key rotation logs. Target: drop by Thursday EOD.

priya-sec: I can pull screenshots from Console > Settings > SSO and Console > IAM > Roles. I'll redact user emails from logs. Do they need a full role matrix or just the most relevant roles?

alex-sales: They said "concise but auditable" — role matrix for org-admin, billing-admin, deployer, and service-account only. Also they want a short signed attestation from Security.

tom-infra: For service accounts: we enforce short-lived tokens (default 14 days for infra tokens) and automated rotation via the key-rotator job. I'll export a redacted audit slice and the rotator job config (Cron + sample output).

rachel-sol: On SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0 group -> role mappings and allow provisioning to be limited to mapped groups only. I'll prepare a how-to doc and a sample mapping screenshot. Example mapping we show in docs: IdP group "platform-engineers" -> Redwood role "deployer:execute".

priya-sec: SAML attribute example (YAML):

priya-sec: ```yaml
name_id_format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
attributes:
  - name: email
    source: email
  - name: groups
    source: http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/claims/Group
  - name: user_uuid
    source: user_id
```

priya-sec: I'll include the metadata URL and ACS endpoint for their verifier.

rachel-sol: MFA policy we show to customers (plain text snippet):

rachel-sol: "MFA required for interactive SSO sessions if user is member of group 'org-admin' or 'billing-admin'; otherwise MFA is recommended. Enforcement is applied at IdP with conditional rules and enforced at session creation in Redwood."

rachel-sol: Also attaching one console screenshot showing MFA enforcement toggle and a link to our Okta/Azure SSO guide.

alex-sales: They asked if SCIM can be restricted to a subset of groups and whether mappings are one-to-one or many-to-one. Answer?

rachel-sol: Yes — you can restrict provisioning to mapped groups only. Mappings support many-to-one (multiple IdP groups -> single Redwood role) and one-to-many (one group -> multiple roles) depending on admin preferences. I'll include the mapping UI screenshot and the API example.

rachel-sol: SCIM PATCH example for tests: 

rachel-sol: ```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Groups/{groupId}
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-99"}]}]}'
```

priya-sec: For RBAC/least-privilege, we'll export the trimmed CSV with these columns: role_id, role_name, surfaces (console/api/billing), permissions_sample. I'll mark which permissions are elevated.

tom-infra: I'll also add evidence of separation of duties: change to org-admin requires an internal PR + two approvers from Security/Platform. I'll attach the redacted PR checklist screenshot.

alex-sales: About the attestation: they want a one-paragraph signed statement from Security that artifacts are current as of a specific date. Priya, can you draft and sign?

priya-sec: Yes — draft: "Security attests that the attached artifacts (SSO metadata, SCIM mappings, MFA policy screenshots, RBAC exports, and redacted audit logs) accurately reflect Redwood Inference access controls and provisioning behavior as of 2025-04-02. For verification, contact security@redwood.example.com." Will include my contact and PGPing options.

audit-bot: Note: nightly audit export finished at 03:10 UTC (audit-export/2025-04-01-0310.csv).

rachel-sol: Plan: I'll assemble the SCIM/SAML examples and the HOWTO; Tom will provide rotation logs and the rotator Cron config; Priya will add screenshots + attestation; Alex will package and upload.

alex-sales: Upload destination: https://redwood.app/shared/sales/poc-778/evidence. Please drop final artifacts by Thu 23:59 UTC. I'll notify the reviewer once uploaded.

priya-sec: Roger. Will ping here when things are in the folder. :white_check_mark:
